$comment: Source for assets/audio/manifest.json (scripts/audio/manifest.mjs measures every file and writes the manifest). Sounds, tiers, music states and throttles are S5's. A screen mood the pack does not list (map, results, finale) plays the grotto loop (the shell's musicFor).

music.note: Loops are mastered to their loudness tier (music -23 LUFS, musicCalm -26 LUFS), so play the bus at 1.0 by default; the parents' settings scale it down.

effects.note: Effects are mastered to their tier; playEffect has no per-call gain, so the mix is in the files.

music.use: grotto and battle loops, the victory sting

musicCalm.use: practice loop: unobtrusive while the child thinks
